description.value:
Drunk, it tastes of nothing at all, and for a moment you can hear yourself, a step behind.

For 10 minutes after you drink this potion (a bonus action), you leave echoes: silent, translucent copies of you. One appears where you stand when you drink it, and another where you stand at the start of each of your turns, up to three at a time.

Which of you is real? While at least one echo is within 5 feet of you, attack rolls against you have disadvantage. When an attack would hit you, roll a d6 for each echo within 5 feet of you. If any of them rolls a 3 or higher, one of those echoes takes the hit instead and is destroyed, and the attack misses you. Echoes farther away don't confuse your attackers, but they are the ones you can step to.

Step. When an attack hits you and you can see one of your echoes more than 5 feet away, you can trade places with it: you appear where the echo was and the echo where you were, and the attack strikes the echo instead, even on a critical hit. The echo bursts, dealing 3d8 force damage to the attacker. Your first step each round costs nothing; any further step that round uses your reaction.

A creature that attacks an echo itself and hits destroys it.

When the potion's magic ends, your last echo remains for a day, with your face and your voice, saying nothing.

midi-qol: The echoes' d6s are rolled when you are attacked, before the hit is checked, against your Armor Class (cover and other changes to Armor Class are not counted); if an echo takes the hit, Step is not offered. Echo distances are measured when you are attacked. Step is offered in midi's reaction prompt when you are hit and can see an echo more than 5 feet away, so it only appears while your reaction is unused; the first step each combat round gives the reaction back, and outside combat stepping never uses it. It moves you to the echo you choose (if more than one qualifies), makes that one attack miss and deals the burst to the attacker; the echo is gone afterwards. Echoes are unlinked copies of your token, created through DAE, so harm to them never reaches you; the last one is left for the GM to remove.

activation.condition: When you are hit by an attack and you can see an echo more than 5 feet away

effects.name: Echoing Step
effects.description: Up to three echoes of you, a new one where you stand at the start of each of your turns. While one is within 5 feet of you, attacks against you have disadvantage, and when an attack would hit you, a d6 for each of those: on any 3 or higher an echo takes the hit instead. When hit, you can trade places with an echo you can see more than 5 feet away: the attack strikes the echo, which bursts against the attacker. The first step each round costs nothing; a second uses your reaction.

effects.description: While one of your echoes is within 5 feet of you, attack rolls against you have disadvantage.
